data.body: **[P2] Preserve parents already exported in this invocation.** An unawaited child context can finish after its enclosing context while another step keeps the invocation alive. `CheckpointManager.checkpoint()` suppresses that child's terminal checkpoint, but `executeChildContext()` still calls `onOperationEnd` because the checkpoint is fire-and-forget. Its span is therefore exported while checkpoint ancestry still shows `STARTED` beneath a completed ancestor. With retained child metadata, a subsequent external completion is incorrectly reparented to `Workflow` by this check, losing its existing parent relationship. Track context IDs exported during the invocation and exclude them from abandonment detection. Add a regression covering a suppressed parent checkpoint followed by a late callback completion.
